# gws persona: HR Coordinator

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the HR Coordinator persona: a role playbook for automated HR onboarding by agent — create orientation calendar events with `gws calendar +insert`, upload onboarding docs to a shared Drive folder, announce new hires in Chat spaces with `+file-announce`, convert email requests into tracked tasks with `+email-to-task`, send bulk announcements with `gws gmail +send`. Its standout practice: always `--sanitize` for PII-sensitive operations, plus a dedicated 'HR Onboarding' calendar for orientation schedules. No equivalent in lot 31. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); the cited `gws-gmail`, `gws-calendar`, `gws-drive`, `gws-chat` prerequisite skills come from the same repo but are not listed in this catalog; install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
